case_title: WOOTEN LESTER E VS G R E DEVELOPER CONTRACTORS et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $450.00 FILED BY WOOTEN LESTER E AS TO DEFENDANT G R E DEVELOPER CONTRACTORS RAUGH GARY ZANARKI SHARON ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-07-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT G R E DEVELOPER CONTRACTORS

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WOOTEN LESTER E IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT G R E DEVELOPER CONTRACTORS RAUGH GARY ZANARKI SHARON STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
